SMA.formula: arithmetic mean of the immediately preceding n completed closes including t

POPULATION_SD.formula: sqrt(sum((x-mean)^2)/n) over the same n closes used by SMA

EMA.seed: first EMA value equals SMA of first n available completed closes; subsequent EMA_t=alpha*x_t+(1-alpha)*EMA_(t-1)

TEMA.formula: 3*EMA1-3*EMA2+EMA3; EMA2 applies the same frozen EMA operator to the valid EMA1 sequence; EMA3 applies it to valid EMA2

RSI14.seed: first average gain/loss = arithmetic mean of gains/losses over first 14 close-to-close changes
RSI14.value: 100 when avg_loss=0 and avg_gain>0; 50 when both zero; otherwise 100-100/(1+avg_gain/avg_loss)

morning_star_reason: The frozen prereg uses the qualitative term 'large first body' without an ex-ante numeric threshold. No threshold may be invented after registration, even before reading outcomes, because that would amend a registered candidate rather than clarify a standard operator.
